title: Sub-graphs and node expansion
hook: A sub-graph is a front-end idea that the server never sees. Node expansion is a server idea that the front-end never sees.

verified.claim: validate_prompt refuses a class_type it can't find, so a sub-graph's UUID type can't reach the executor.
A test node really expanded, adding ids 2.0.0.1 to 2.0.0.3, with a result reached through a wire.
Core's Start Loop ran its body 3 times through expansion, on a CPU with a stub for the server.
Inner nodes of a sub-graph use compound ids such as 1:2:3.
Saved workflows keep sub-graphs under definitions.subgraphs.
verified.ref: docs.comfy.org interface features subgraph, and the blueprints in ComfyUI

unchecked: We did not read the front-end source for the flattening step. That it happens is inferred from validate_prompt and the docs' compound ids.
The lab's flatten function is our own simplified version of what the front end must do, so it isn't the front end's code.
